name: Geria (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over light blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Geria (a castle on red and a tree above waves).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 8 August 1996 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 3 September 1996; the arms are per fess, first gules a castle or with three crenellated donjons masoned sable, and the flag is rectangular, of proportion 1:2, per fess yellow and sky blue with the municipal arms in their colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Geria arms — castle on red and a tree above waves
